title_protection.quote: No limited licensed electrician shall be authorized to use the appellation "contractor" or any other designation that gives or is designed to give the impression that a limited licensed electrician is a contractor unless the limited licensed electrician also holds a valid contractor's license issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may revoke or suspend license for faulty electrical work performed by the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board for licensing contractors may revoke or suspend the license of a limited licensed electrician for faulty electrical work performed by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension for gross negligence, incompetency, fraud, dishonest dealing or misconduct in contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whenever any person, firm or corporation claims to have been damaged or injured by the gross negligence, incompetency, fraud, dishonest dealing or misconduct in the practice of contracting on the part of any person, firm or corporation licensed under this part files suit upon the claim ... the court may, as a part of its decree or judgment in the case, revoke the certificate of license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse to issue or renew license for lack of financial stability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to issue or renew a license to any person, firm or corporation for lack of financial stability, lack of expertise, submission of false evidence with regard to application of license or renewal, conviction of a felony and any other conduct that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing or violation of the statute.

bonding_required.quote: No person shall be required to post a bond, provide a financial statement or provide a letter of reference in order to obtain a license as a limited licensed electrician.

insurance_required.quote: Any application for initial licensure or for renewal of licensure also shall be accompanied by an affidavit affirming that the applicant maintains general liability insurance and workers' compensation insurance

definition_quote.value: "Limited licensed electrician" means any person or entity that performs any electrical work that has a total cost of less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) and that is required to be registered under § 68-102-150

scope_exclusions.quote: any single residence homeowner is exempt from the limited licensed electrician requirements of this part for purposes of performing electrical work on the homeowner's own residence ... a license as a limited licensed electrician shall not be required in any municipality or county that issues licenses to persons who perform electrical work in the municipality or county.

qualifier_required.quote: Corporations and partnerships may engage in the business of contracting; provided, that at least one (1) of the major stockholders or partners or full-time employees with a written power of attorney to bind the corporation or partnership has sufficient knowledge of the construction business in which the persons are licensed to perform.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If the person who took the examination for the partnership or corporation leaves the firm for any reason, the partnership or corporation must designate an individual to take the examination within three (3) months.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: The application shall also be accompanied by evidence of the applicant's current workers' compensation insurance coverage.
